items.title: The Dialectical Theorem
items.excerpt: We consider the future of mathematics as a profession in a world where artificial intelligence may surpass human mathematicians in essentially every technical task. Through an informal dialogue, we explore why human mathematical expertise might nevertheless remain valuable, what kinds of expertise universities should cultivate, and how graduate education might adapt. We also discuss the institutional and economic uncertainties that threaten the continued existence of a thriving mathematical profession, even if the value of human mathematical understanding endures.

items.title: A lower bound of 21 for 3 × 3 matrix multiplication over every field
items.excerpt: Proved · Algebraic complexity; exact bilinear complexity and tensor rank · with GPT-6 Astra (gpt-6-astra), with GPT-6 Sol (gpt-6-sol) used for part of the work · significance 30/100. For a field K, what is the smallest number r of products of input linear forms needed to multiply two arbitrary 3\times3 matrices exactly? Equivalently, how small can r be in an identity AB=\sum_{i=1}^{r}a_i(A)b_i(B)W_i holding for every pair A,B, with K-linear forms a_i,b_i and fixed matrices W_i? items.title: Dow–Tkachuk Question 4.8: pseudocomplete countable closures in C_p(X) force X to be a P-space
items.excerpt: Proved · General topology; $C_p$-theory · with ChatGPT Astra (proof); Claude Opus 5.5 (Lean formalization) · significance 8/100. Dow and Tkachuk asked (Question 4.8): assume that the closure of A is pseudocomplete for every countable A \subset C_p(X). Must the Tychonoff space X be a P-space? Here C_p(X) is the space of continuous real-valued functions on X with the topology of pointwise convergence, pseudocompleteness is in Oxtoby's sense (a sequence of \pi-bases along which every closure-nested choice has nonempty intersection), and a P-space is one in which every G_\delta set is open.

items.title: Wall's D(2) problem
items.excerpt: Disproved · Algebraic topology; homotopy types of 2-complexes · with Unreleased internal OpenAI model · significance 46/100. A finite connected CW complex X with fundamental group G satisfies the D(2) condition if H_i(\widetilde X;\mathbb Z)=0 for i>2 and H^3(X;M)=0 for every finitely generated \mathbb ZG-module M. Wall showed such X has a finite three-dimensional model and asked whether the three-cells can be removed. items.title: The 3SUM hypothesis: is 3SUM solvable in truly subquadratic time?
items.excerpt: Disproved · Fine-grained complexity; algorithms · with Claude (internal Anthropic research model, unnamed) · significance 50/100. Given n integers in [-n^c, n^c], decide whether three of them sum to zero. The 3SUM hypothesis asserts that no algorithm on a word RAM with O(\log n)-bit words solves this in O(n^{2-\varepsilon}) time for any \varepsilon > 0. items.title: The strong isotropic constant conjecture: simplices maximize the isotropic constant
items.excerpt: Proved · Convex geometry; isotropic constants and the slicing problem · with Unreleased internal OpenAI model · significance 50/100. For a convex body K\subset\mathbb R^n with covariance matrix \Sigma_K of the uniform distribution, the isotropic constant is L_K=(\det\Sigma_K/|K|^2)^{1/(2n)}, an affine invariant. Bourgain's slicing problem asked for a dimension-free upper bound, recently obtained by Klartag and Lehec. items.title: The 8/3-plus stability conjecture for power-free binary morphism lengths
items.excerpt: Proved · Combinatorics on words; repetition-free morphisms · with OpenAI Codex · significance 6/100. Shallit, Shur and Zorcic ask for the phase transitions in admissible lengths of uniform binary morphisms preserving repetition avoidance. In Section 4 of Power-free complementary binary morphisms, they conjecture that the set of admissible lengths stays constant whenever (8/3)^+\leq\alpha<3, with another transition at the strict threshold 8/3. Here a morphism is \alpha-free if it sends every \alpha-free binary input word to an \alpha-free output; the plus convention permits exponent exactly 8/3.
items.title_zh: 无幂二元态射长度的 8/3+ 稳定性猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 已证明 · 单词组合学；无重复态射 · 与 OpenAI Codex · 重要性 6/100。 Shallit、Shur 和 Zorcic 要求相变保持在一致二元态射的允许长度内，同时避免重复。在无幂互补二元态射的第 4 节中，他们推测每当 (8/3)^+\leq\alpha<3 时，允许长度的集合保持不变，并在严格阈值 8/3 处进行另一个转换。这里，如果态射将每个无 α 的二进制输入字发送到无 α 的输出，则它是无 α 的； plus 约定允许指数恰好为 8/3。
